mainEntity.name: Do you use Private Blog Networks (PBNs) for guest posting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. All guest posting placements are secured via manual outreach to genuine, active blogs with verified Ahrefs organic search traffic and established domain authority. No PBNs, no link farms, and no automated spam.

mainEntity.name: Are your SEO courses and live Zoom sessions really 100% free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. All courses, downloadable guides, and weekly Sunday Zoom Q&A sessions are completely free of charge. There are no hidden fees, paid tiers, or upsells.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from an SEO campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: While initial technical fixes and indexation improvements are visible within 2 to 4 weeks, significant organic search traffic and revenue growth typically manifest over 3 to 6 months of consistent strategy.

mainEntity.name: Can you provide custom guest posting packages for agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, I offer white-label guest posting and outreach solutions for digital marketing agencies with bulk reporting and customizable metrics.
